# Test template variable substitution edge cases

env PE_TEST_MODE=true

# Test basic template substitution
exec pe run "Hello {{.name}}" --var name=World
stdout 'Hello World'

# Test multiple variables
exec pe run "{{.a}} + {{.b}} = {{.result}}" --var a=2 --var b=3 --var result=5
stdout '2 + 3 = 5'

# Test variables with spaces in values
exec pe run "Say: {{.message}}" --var 'message=Hello World'
stdout 'Hello World'

# Test variables with special characters
exec pe run "Symbol: {{.symbol}}" --var 'symbol=@#$%'
stdout '@#$%'

# Test variables with equals signs in values
exec pe run "Equation: {{.eq}}" --var 'eq=x=y+z'
stdout 'x=y+z'

# Test empty variable value
exec pe run "Empty: {{.empty}}" --var empty=
stdout 'Empty: '

# Test undefined variable (should remain as template)
exec pe run "Undefined: {{.undefined}}"
stdout 'Undefined: {{.undefined}}'

# Test nested template structure
exec cat > nested.txt <<'EOF'
Main: {{.main}}
{{if .show_extra}}
Extra: {{.extra}}
{{end}}
EOF

exec pe run nested.txt --var main=test --var show_extra=true --var extra=bonus
stdout 'Main: test'

# Test variable override precedence (command line should win)
exec cat > override-config.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Variable override test"
prompts:
  - "Value: {{.key}}"
providers:
  - name: "mock"
tests:
  - vars:
      key: "original"
EOF

exec pe eval override-config.yaml --var key=overridden
stdout 'overridden'

# Test malformed template (should handle gracefully)
exec pe run "Malformed: {{.incomplete"
stdout 'Malformed: {{.incomplete'

# Test template with no variables but var flags provided
exec pe run "No templates here" --var unused=value
stdout 'No templates here'

# Test numeric variables
exec pe run "Number: {{.num}}" --var num=42
stdout 'Number: 42'

# Test boolean-like variables
exec pe run "Bool: {{.flag}}" --var flag=true
stdout 'Bool: true'

# Test case sensitivity
exec pe run "Case: {{.Name}} vs {{.name}}" --var Name=Upper --var name=lower
stdout 'Case: Upper vs lower'

-- nested.txt --
Main: {{.main}}
{{if .show_extra}}
Extra: {{.extra}}
{{end}}
